_comment: Interior strike demo (#1834). A 144-man Infantry block (12 files by 12 ranks) stands with a 6-man enemy Infantry squad spawned at its centre, five or six ranks in from every edge. Only a block's near-front ranks strike (three ranks for a 1.3 m gladius at a 0.45 m rank pitch), and 'front' follows the slot grid, so before this fix the men around the squad never struck it. The front-line contact of #1827 does not change that: the two blocks share a centre, so neither lies ahead of the other and the pair keeps its centre-based range. On main 2c2955cc the squad still has all 6 men at tick 600, and the block has lost a man by tick 250 and 2 by tick 400. With the fix every man of the block within reach of an enemy inside it, behind the striking ranks, strikes him: the squad is gone at tick 218 and the block loses nobody. drill:true keeps the battle running after the squad is gone, so the clip shows the block standing afterwards. Deterministic: seed + a custom scenario, no input steps. Verified by a 10-tick and a 2-tick state dump on head and a 10-tick dump on main; both expects below fail on main (the squad is present through tick 600, and the block has 142 men at tick 600).

shape_residual.reason: After the squad dies (tick 218) the block is judged out of contact while it recovers from its slot grid winding round under the men during the fight: with the enemy at its centre, each small combat re-face snaps the heading toward a moving bearing and turns the whole grid (#1792), 110 degrees of facing travel between ticks 2 and 218 (measured on cf524f87). Dense 2-tick worst 18.5 against 13.5 over ticks 218 to 600; the 10-tick declared samples here read 18.4. Main never leaves contact in this clip, so it is never judged. Remove once #1792 lands.
